'''Peter J. Hansen''' is an American [[animal scientist]] and [[physiologist]] who serves as distinguished professor and L.E. "Red" Professor of Animal Sciences in the Department of Animal Sciences at [[University of Florida]]<ref name=pjh>{{cite web |title=Peter Hansen |url=https://animal.ifas.ufl.edu/people/peter-hansen/ |website= Department of Animal Sciences - University of Florida}}</ref>

==Research==
Hansen's interest in livestock species started early in life while staying with relatives in [[County Wexford]] Ireland <ref name=Awards2010 />  He first did research while an undergraduate in the Dept. of Dairy Science at the [[University of Illinois]] under the tutelage of Charles E. Graves. His doctoral research focused on regulation of reproduction by photoperiod in cattle and mice. Postdoctoral work with [[R. Michael Roberts|Roberts]] and [[Fuller Bazer|Bazer]] kindled a love for understanding the establishment and maintenance of pregnancy, which subsequently became a career-long research interest.  Among the most notable achievements as a faculty member at Florida has been identifying embryokines (see [[embryokine]]) that regulate development of the preimplantation embryo, demonstrating sex-dependent developmental programming during the preimplantation period, understanding how elevated temperature compromises reproduction, development of embryo transfer to increase pregnancy rate in heat-stressed cows, demonstration of the importance of the slick mutation in the prolactin receptor gene for increasing thermotolerance of cattle, and characterization of mechanisms for inhibition of uterine immune function by progesterone.

== Notable Awards ==
Hansen was the recipient of the highest awards given by the American Society of Reproductive Immunology, [[American Dairy Science Association]]<ref name=Awards2010 /> and the [[American Society of Animal Science]].<ref>{{cite web |title=National Awards ASAS |url=https://www.asas.org/about/national-awards}}</ref> He was the 2026 recipient of the Simmet Prize.<ref>{{cite web|title=Simmet Prize|url=https://animalreproduction.org/simmetprize/}}</ref> He is a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (2007),<ref>{{cite web |title=UF FACULTY IN THE AAAS |url=http://aa.ufl.edu/awards/highly-prestigious-external-awards/aaas/uf-faculty-in-the-aaas/ |website=University of Florida}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Historic AAAS Fellows |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic/ |website=American Association for the Advancement of Science}}</ref> [[American Dairy Science Association]] (2009),<ref>{{cite web |title=Awards Program of the American Dairy Science Association |url=https://www.journalofdairyscience.org/article/S0022-0302(09)2550-0/fulltext |website=Dairy Science |date=December 2009}}</ref> [[American Society of Animal Science]] (2018) <ref>{{cite web |title=Peter J. Hansen |url=https://www.asas.org/about/national-awards/past-awardees/award-winner-detail/peter-j.-hansen---fellow |website=American Society of Animal Science}}</ref> and the Society for the Study of Reproduction (2021) <ref>{{cite web |title=SSR Press Release 2021 Distinguished Fellows |url=https://www.ssr.org/awards-scholarships/2021fellows}}</ref>
